svg.title: 01 Initial Belief
svg.desc: Plot: initial belief about position as a Gaussian with mean 4.0 and variance 1.0, shown as a filled bell curve peaking at x equals 4. Nearly all probability lies between about x equals 1 and 7 on a position axis running from 0 to 15. This is the starting estimate before the predict step is applied.
